t: You're outside The Dilly, a luxury hotel at 21 Piccadilly. For over a hundred years it was known as The Piccadilly Hotel, and it has only recently taken its new name. The building was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He's considered among the greatest of British architects, known for country houses and for commercial buildings like this one, and his influence was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s.
